justification: The assessment also explicitly challenges ⟨S₁⟩ = Aut(M_(1,2)). Its example verifies this same defect: M_(1,2) is edgeless on {1,2,3,4}, so (1 4) is an automorphism, while every element of ⟨S₁⟩ fixes 4. This supplies a valid block-mixing witness matching the ground truth, alongside its separate Step 4 objection.
